Commentary.Commentary: Zimbabwe once again failed to convert the start and are put in dire straits in the Test. Sri Lanka will now look to swell this lead and it will be interesting to see how much will the visitors feel is enough to hand over the willow to the Rhodesians again. Let's see how the second phase of the Test match pans out. Join us back shortly.

So, Sri Lanka have decided that they will bat again, in spite of getting a heavy lead of 232 runs in the bank. The pair of Brian Chari and Craig Ervine didn't last long this morning as once the latter got out, no one in the middle and lower middle order could resurrect the innings. It was the skipper Rangana Herath who spun the web beautifully and registered yet another 5-fer to his name. Lakmal and Perera chipped in as well and overall it was a collective effort from the Lankan bowlers.

OUT! ZIMBABWE HAVE BEEN CLEANED UP! Length ball on middle and leg, Donald Tiripano backs away and mistimes his hoick towards mid on. Herath is the man there and he dives low to his left to take a good catch. He's hurt his hand in the process but he seems to be fine, nothing too serious. So with that, ZIMBABWE ARE ALL OUT FOR 272!
Another lbw appeal but this one is turned down. It's sliding down leg as Mpofu looks to put bat on ball.
Chris Mpofu is the last man in!
27th Test fifer for Herath!

OUT! HERATH WITH ANOTHER ONE! He now becomes only the 3rd player after Muralitharan and Dale Steyn to get a 5-fer against all the 9 Test playing nations. He comes from around the wicket and drifts in an arm ball on middle and off, Mumba lunges forward to block but misses the ball completely and is caught plumb in front of the stumps. The umpire raises his finger but Mumba takes a review against it. He must have thought might as well since 2 reviews are left. He takes it but to no avail as the replays show him to be gone.
Mumba has been adjudged leg before. He's however decided to take a review against the decision.
Carl Mumba has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Turning away outside off, it's played to point for one run.
Arm ball from Rangi, he pitches it outside off, Tiripano looks to poke at it but is beaten as the ball goes past the outside edge.
Floats this one up around off, blocked.
Rangana Herath brings himself back on to bowl.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Carl rises on his toes and punches it through the covers for a couple of runs.
Curving in on a good length from around the off stump, Carl Mumba gets big on the ball and defends it back in the direction of the bowler.
Shaping in on middle and leg, it's clipped through the leg side for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Second new ball has been taken by Sri Lanka in the mid over!
Another fullish delivery from Suranga Lakmal, it's driven towards mid on for nothing.
Fuller length delivery on off stump, it's kept out solidly off the front foot.

Not out! A very, very close call for Carl. Arm ball outside off, Carl looks to play it off the front foot but misses as the ball goes past the outside edge. He's slightly off balance at this point as Kusal Perera whips the bails off. He appeals for a stumping and the decision goes upstairs. Replays show Mumba is safe. An eventful over comes to an end.
A stumping appeal against Carl Mumba is referred upstairs.
Shortish outside off, it's defended off the back foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Straighter one outside off, Mumba looks to push it away on the off side but fails to get any bat on ball.
Drifting in on a fuller length from around off, Mumba lunges forward to block it out.
Carl Mumba is the next man in to bat.

OUT! What was PJ Moor trying to do there? That's such a poor shot to play. Even he knew it straight away. Short and flat on middle, it's turning in and skidding a bit off the surface as well. Moor goes back and looks to glance it away but misses and is caught plumb in front of the stumps. Roaring appeals go up for a leg before and the umpire wastes no time in raising his finger.
Great save, there. Full and outside off, Tiripano drives it hard towards short cover. The fielder there is alert and he dives low to this right to stop the ball from going past him. Athletic stuff.
Another bouncer from Lahiru Kumara, Donald Tiripano is very watchful as he crouches low to let it sail over him.
Angling down the leg side, Donald has nothing to do with that one.
Fullish ball attacking the stumps, Tiripano stays behind the line to defend.
Aiming the hips, Moor glances it down towards fine leg for a single.
Kumara begins with a short one, on middle and off, Peter Moor has no problem as he ducks to let it go over him.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Some nice drift on that as it's pitched around off, Tiripano strides forward and taps it in front of cover-point for a quick single. Gets off the mark with that.
Donald Tiripano is the new man in!
Drinks are on the field!

OUT! WHAT A CATCH FROM DIMUTH! An absolute blinder. It's still unbelievable how he even held on to it. Fuller and flat well outside off, Graeme Cremer flashes his bat hard at it. Gets a big edge which rockets straight to Karunaratne at second slip. No idea how but he got his hands up in a flash and caught it reverse cupped. Ridiculous stuff! That was taken on pure instincts. The Zimbabwean skipper has to make the long walk back and that's another wicket for Sri Lanka.
Fired in full outside off, Cremer looks to go hard through the off side but fails to make any connection.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full around off, kept out from within the crease.
FOUR! Two in two! He's so wonderful to watch when he plays like this. Straying on the hips, Moor just glances this away through backward square leg for consecutive boundaries.

FOUR! That's a beauty! Lovely placement from PJ Moor. Good length delivery outside off, with an angled bat the Zimbabwean keeper glides it through backward point to send it all the way. Got it through the gap nicely. Beautiful shot.
Fired in on the pads, it's clipped through the square leg region for a run.
On a good length once more, outside off, it's glided through backward point towards third man for a single.
Good length delivery on middle and leg, it's kept out from deep within the crease. Solidly done.
Fuller and angling on middle from around the wicket, Moor bunts it back to the bowler.
Lahiru Kumara is called back into the attack!
Edged and away! Another close call for a Zimbabwean batsman. Full outside off, Cremer goes after it and gets an edge which flies past the diving first slip fielder. Two runs are taken.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and on the stumps, Graeme Cremer dead-bats it into the track.
Another slightly flatter, some drift on that occasion, Cremer comes half-forward and brings his bat in front of his pad to defend.
Full ball around off, it's kept out off the front foot.
The skipper Graeme Cremer walks in next, replacing Williams!

OUT! SEAN IS GONE! What a review by the Lankans. Dilruwan Perera has struck gold for his team here. He's got the big fish and against the run of play, too. He bowls a flatter delivery from around the wicket, it's sliding in from around off. Williams leans forward and across to paddle it fine down the leg side but misses and is hit on the front pad. There are loud appeals for an lbw but the umpire turns it down. Dilruwan talks it out with is captain and then, the skipper takes the review. Replays show the ball to be hitting the stump and Williams is caught dead plumb. What a wicket! The southpaw was looking solid and was the key for the home side. The Islanders will be looking to wrap it up soon.
Williams is caught leg before but is adjudged not out. Sri Lanka are not convinced and have decided to take a review against the decision.
Short one on middle and leg, it's ducked and evaded to end the over.
From over the wicket now, Suranga with a back of a length delivery coming in on middle and off, PJ Moor stays in his crease and keeps it out from within the crease.
Short and wide outside off, SW reaches out to it and hits it towards deep point to pick up a single.
Lakmal once again pitches it up and it's outside off, Sean Williams leans forward and drives it hard, but it's straight to the man at mid off.
On a good length and pitched well outside off, Sean shoulders his arms to this one.

FOUR! Beautiful shot! Fuller length ball well outside off, from around the wicket, Williams leans into the shot and drives it wonderfully through the gap in the covers to send it all the way to the boundary line.
Drifting in around middle, Moor defends it off the outer part of the bat.
Angles it in from outside, Williams chops it off the back foot.

Slides it down the leg side and Moor tries to pull it across the line. He tries his best but fails to put bat on ball. The keeper fails to collect it as well and the ball goes down to fine leg. The fielder gives it a chase and does well to scoop the ball back. Three leg byes taken!
Tossed up ball around off, driven uppishly through covers for a couple.
Fuller around off, pushed back to Perera.
Short and sliding in with the angle, Moor gets back to cut it on the off side but gets beaten.
Dilruwan Perera is back into the attack!
Fractionally overpitched on off, driven straight to the man at mid off.
Fuller and angled in, it's driven back to the bowler who stops it by bending to his left in his followthrough.
Very close to the off stump line, Williams makes another watchful leave to the keeper.
Slants across a length ball outside off, Williams doesn't fiddle with it.
In the channel outside off, Williams shoulders his arms to that one.
Good length ball on middle, SW hangs back and defends.
Suranga Lakmal is back into the attack.

FOUR! Delightful! Once again Rangi gives this one a bit more flight and serves it outside off. Moor makes a bit of room and goes inside out over extra cover. A couple of bounces and into the fence she goes. Brilliant!
Tosses it up around off, Moor drives it through extra cover and comes back for a double.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Floated ball around middle and off, Moor defends it down gently.
Loopy ball around middle, the batsman digs it out on the off side.
Tossed up ball around middle, defended from within the crease.
Angling in on a length on middle and leg, it's turned towards square leg for a single.
Over the wicket to Peter Moor, it's kept out solidly from within the crease.
Fuller in length this time, it's driven down towards mid on for a brisk single.

FOUR! THAT'S CHEEKY FROM WILLIAMS! Kumara bangs it in short and angles it in from around off, Williams leans back and ramps it over the keeper's head. Sends it all the way and what a way to bring up his fifty. It's his first in this format and he's played so well here. Needs to carry on, though. His side needs a big score from him.
Williams is inching closer towards a half-century here...
Back of a length ball on off, tapped on the off side for one.
Misfield! Fuller in length and outside off, Williams drives it towards short cover where the fielder parries it to mid off and that allows them to take a single.
Floated ball around off, hit hard but finds short extra cover.
Gets back and punches it towards short extra cover.
Comes forward and defends it down gently.
Flattish ball around middle, punched off the back foot towards covers.
FOUR! Out of the blue! Herath gives this a truck loaded with lots of flight and Peter Moor stamps his authority over it. Clears the front leg and goes bang over Rangana's head for a boundary.
Around middle and leg, Williams gets down and paddles it down to fine leg for a single.
Banged in short on middle, it's fended on the leg side by PM.
Back of a length ball on middle, Moor offers a straight bat defense.
Short of a length ball on middle, rises off the deck as well. Moor drops his wrists down and gets hit on the left shoulder.
Fires in a yorker on middle, Moor does well to bring his bat down and jam it out on the on side.
Comes from around the wicket and bowls it on middle and off, Moor blocks it down.
Angles a length ball on the middle stump, tucked towards the on side for a single.
FOUR! Shot, that! Herath drops it short on middle, Moor gets back immediately, picks up the length and puts it over mid-wicket for a boundary. Really played it well, Peter.
Pushed quicker through the air and gets it to skid in with the angle. Moor stays back and defends.
Around off, Williams gets down on one knee and just paddles it behind square on the leg side for a single.
An arm ball around off, Williams off the front foot pushes it to covers.
Slider around middle and leg, flicked off the back foot towards backward square leg for a quick single.
Loopy around off, Moor comes forward and pushes it towards covers.
Good length ball on the pads, it's clipped towards the man at mid on for a quick single.
Very full and angling at the base of the off stump. Moor digs it out in time.
Banged in short on middle, Moor sits down to let that one sail over him to the keeper.
Angles in a length ball on middle, Moor gets behind and punches it back to Kumara.
Another bumper on middle, Peter leaves it alone.
Short of a length ball on middle and leg, Moor sits under it.
Loopy ball around off, buried into the ground.
Flighted ball around off, straightens a bit after pitching. Sean comes forward to defend but misses as the ball goes past the outside edge to the keeper.
Keeps his bat in front of the pads and defends it.
Loopy ball around off, pushed off the front foot through covers for a single.
Floated ball around off, defended down gently.
Tossed up ball on middle, Williams gets down, takes it on the full and paddles it down to fine leg for a single.
Length ball on middle, defended from within the crease.
Good length delivery on the pads, worked through square leg for an easy single.
Banged in short on leg, Williams ducks to evade it.
Fuller and angling in, clipped through mid-wicket for a single. They look for the second but won't get it.
Fuller in length and angling in, Sean looks to drive it down the ground but gets it off the inner part of the bat towards mid on for a single.
Back of a length ball on off, Williams hangs back and defends it towards covers.
Lahiru Kumara to bowl from the other end!
Little bit of air through the off side, pushed towards covers.
Full and around middle, the batsman gets across and defends it.
Loopy ball around off, defended off the front foot towards the off side.
Tossed up ball around middle, worked towards short mid-wicket.

Welcome back for the second session, folks! Sean Williams is now joined by Peter Moor and the duo would want to at least avoid the follow-on. Rangana Herath will finish his pending over. Let's play...
...DAY 3, SESSION 2...

28.2 overs, 84 runs and 3 wickets - This is what the opening session has produced. The visiting side will be quite content and will look to run through the lower middle order as quick as possible. Sean Williams is once again the key man for the home side and he will have to dig deep here. Another 95 runs are needed for Zimbabwe to avoid the follow-on. Should be an interesting second session. It'll begin in a short while.

Zimbabwe will be disappointed with that last wicket. Despite losing their overnight and set batsmen, the ship was steadied with Williams and Waller taking the reins. But the latter fell prey to Herath just before the break and that will have dented a rather big hole in the hosts' confidence.

With that wicket in the last over before the break, the session has heavily tilted in Sri Lanka's favour. Once again it's the Lankan skipper who has come up with the goods. He's picked up 2 wickets in the session, one of the important Brian Chari and now, of Malcolm Waller. But, a special mention has to be put for Suranga Lakmal. The pacer started things off as he dismissed Craig Ervine and broke the 117-run stand. He bowled his heart out and was superb.

OUT! Rangana Herath strikes just at the stroke of lunch. He brought himself into the attack and got what he wanted. Complete brain fade from Malcolm Waller, should have survived this over. Tosses it up around off, asking Waller to go after it. He accepts the proposal and goes for a drive. Fails to keep it down and ends up spooning a catch to Kaushal Silva at short extra cover who dives in front and takes it inches above the ground. With that, it's LUNCH ON DAY 3!
Tossed up ball around middle and off, driven towards the man at mid off.
Last over before Lunch and it will be Rangana Herath to have a go with the ball. Will he be able to scalp a wicket here?

FOUR! That's creamed away! What a shot from the southpaw! Fractionally overpitched on off, Williams makes little bit of room and unfurls a lovely cover drive. It had enough legs to get it across the fence.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

FOUR! Flayed! Short of a length ball on off, too much of width on offer and Williams just loves it. He stays put and carves it over backward point for a boundary. The fielder comes across to his right but fails to stop it from crossing the rope.
Length ball in the channel on off, Williams defends it again.
Yorker on middle, SW jams it out back to the bowler.
Angles it in from outside off, Sean Williams prods forward and defends it solidly.
Flattish on middle, Waller stays back and defends it with a straight bat.
Quicker through the air on off, Waller pushes it tamely towards point.
Loopy ball around off, driven straight to mid off.
Tossed up outside off, Sean gets forward and drives it towards covers for a single.
On middle and leg, flicked past the man at short leg.
Darts it in around off, pushed off the front foot towards mid off.
Angles it on the pads, clipped through the gap at mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller in length ball on off, Malcolm drives it with soft hands towards covers for a single. 200 up for Zimbabwe!
Length ball on middle and off, Waller hangs back to defend.

What happened there? Back of a length ball outside off, Waller looks to cut but gets a thick inside edge on the pads as the ball rolls towards the off side. The pair decide to take a single and the fielder charging in to the ball has a shy at the striker's end but misses. Maybe, he overran and with the momentum he dashes into the stumps. The ball deflects off the timber to square leg and they take one more.
Fuller in length and outside off, Waller defends it solidly off the front foot.
Starts with a short of length ball outside off, Waller has got nothing to offer on that one.
Lahiru Kumara comes into the attack now.
Gets behind the line and blocks it out gently.
Darted in on middle, driven towards mid on for a single.
Pushed through the cover region for a single.

Stumping chance missed! Perera gives this a gentle flight around off, Williams looks to defend it off the front foot but the ball turns away and he gets beaten. K. Perera behind the stumps is late to react and replays show Sean's back foot was in the air and the keeper could have whipped off the bails.
Tosses it up around off, Williams gets back and defends.
Full and around off, Williams prods forward and defends it into the ground.
Short and outside off, Waller rocks back and punches it through covers for a couple of runs.
Leg bye! A slider around middle and leg, Williams gets back to flick it through the leg side but misses as the ball goes off the pads past short leg. A leg bye is taken.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Angles it in on off, Waller makes room and milks it down to long off for a single.
Tossed up around off, pushed off the front foot towards short extra cover.
Slider around middle, Waller pushes it down the track.
Floated delivery around middle and off, Sean defends it down watchfully.
Plunges forward to this loopy ball and blocks it out on the off side.
Flattish one outside off, Williams initially goes for it but then at the last moment shoulders his arms to it.
Tossed up ball around off, pushed towards covers for a quick single.
Quicker through the air on off, Malcolm gets back and dabs it behind point for a comfortable two.
Full and around off, Waller defends it towards covers.
Flatter and quicker outside off, it's cut away on the off side.
Herath bowls this on a shorter length outside off, Waller punches this towards point and picks up a single.
A much straighter line from the Lankan skipper, it's kept out watchfully by Malcolm Waller.
Turning in from around off, it's turned away towards the square leg region for a comfortable run.
Loopy and fullish in length around off, Sean Williams gets right behind the line to defend.

FOUR! Doesn't even need to run for that. Beautiful timing from Sean Williams. Looped up around off, Sean gets low to this one and brings out the reverse sweep. Gets it nicely through the covers and gets a boundary to his name.
Flatter and shorter around off, kept out off the back foot. That's the end of an eventful over from Dilruwan Perera.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.

IN THE AIR... AND IT'S SAFE! Waller will have to be more careful about those fielders around him. Short and on the stumps, Malcolm goes back and works this uppishly. It goes just past the short leg fielder and towards mid-wicket as the batsmen take a single.

NOT OUT! THAT'S JUST SHORT! Straighter one around off, Waller hangs his bat out to this one and gets an edge. It goes behind but falls just short of the slip fielder who gets low to try and take it. Close call for the new batsman.
The umpire has referred it upstairs. There was an edge which went behind to first slip. He just wants to make sure whether it carried cleanly or not.
FOUR! Beautiful shot from Malcolm Waller. He lunges forward to this full ball and drives it a bit square on the off side. Gets it through cover-point and away to the boundary line.
Short, flat and wide outside off, Williams cuts it away a bit square on the off side for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Malcolm Waller rocks back and punches it through the cover region for a couple of runs. Is off the mark with that.
Rangana flights this one up nicely around the off stump, Waller comes ahead and keeps it out.
Malcolm Waller is the next man in to bat.

OUT! IT'S THE SKIPPER WITH THE BREAKTHROUGH! It's a big, big wicket for Sri Lanka. Herath comes from around the wicket and bowls an arm ball around off, it's drifting in as Chari comes forward to block. There's a big gap however between bat and pad and the ball goes right through it. Takes the off pole and that brings an end to Brain Chari's brilliant knock. Is quite unfortunate to miss out on his maiden Test century.
Looped up on the stumps, it's driven down to long on for a comfortable single. Zimbabwe need 132 runs to avoid the follow-on.
Herath provides some nice flight on that, tosses it up on middle and off, Williams presses forward and keeps it out with a solid, straight bat.
Darted in full outside off, it goes off the outside edge as Sean looks to play at it.
Rangana Herath is back on to bowl.
Flat and just short on middle and off, a back foot defense by Brian Chari.
Full and flat on the stumps, it's driven down to long on for one run.
Williams once again comes ahead to this fuller ball and blocks.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Similar ball and a similar defensive shot offered by Sean Williams.
From around the wicket, it's flat and shortish outside off, Williams goes back and keeps it out on the off side.
Length ball outside off, left alone easily.
Attacks the stumps once more, it's on middle and off this time, Brian stays right behind the line and blocks.

Another loud lbw appeal! No referral taken and it's understandable why. Clearly it was going down leg. Pitched just back of a length and coming in from middle and off, Chari is rapped on the pads as he looks to flick it away. Appeals for a leg before go around but the umpire rightly turns it down.
Good length delivery outside off, Chari walks down the track but then decides to leave it alone.
Length ball outside off, Sean plays this towards mid off and runs to the other end for a quick single.
FOUR! That's a lovely shot. Overpitched outside off from around the wicket, Williams nicely leans into the drive and creams it through the gap in the covers to send it all the way. Pure class, that.
Shortish outside off, punched away off the back foot to end the over.
Flatter and drifting around off, Brian stays behind the line and defends.

You can sense a little pressure building up on Brian Chari. It's full and outside off, Chari looks to drag the sweep through mid-wicket but the ball goes under his bat. There's no need for him to do that, really.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Darted on the stumps, worked away on the leg side for a single.
Loopy and pitched up outside off, driven to mid off.

FOUR! But that was a close one. A rare lapse in concentration from Brian Chari. Fullish length ball well outside off, Chari reaches out to this one and has a go at it. Gets a thick outside edge which flies past gully. Races away to the fence for a boundary.
Fuller length delivery on middle and leg, Sean from within his crease wrists it towards mid-wicket for a comfortable single.
Fullish in length outside off, Chari plays it in front of covers and scurries to the other end to complete a quick run.
Short on off, Williams is a little cramped for room but it doesn't matter. He backs away, makes a little room for himself and slaps it away towards deep backward point for a single.
On a good length once more and it's angling in from around off, Sean Williams is once again solid in his defense.

Lakmal continues his spell and comes from around the wicket, angles in a length delivery from outside off. Williams stands his ground and with an angled bat, taps it in front of the second slip fielder.

Drinks break! A fine first hour for Sri Lanka as they have broken the 117-run stand between Chari and Ervine. It was Lakmal who bowled exceptionally well from one end. Herath bowled good too but wasn't that threatening at all. Brian Chari is still out there and would want to convert this into a big one. An interesting next hour beckons.
A slider around middle and off, Chari is solid in his defense as he keeps it out on the off side.
Around middle and leg, very full as well. Williams comes forward and wrists it through mid on for a single.
Floated ball around off, Williams prods forward and defends it down gently.
Flatter through the air around middle and leg, Chari gets back and works it through mid-wicket for one.
Leg bye! Drifting on the pads, Williams misses his flick as the ball rolls of the pads towards the leg side. A leg bye is taken.
Full and around middle, flicked past the man at short leg.
Full outside off, Brian pushes it towards covers. Williams at the other end wants the single but is quickly sent back by his partner. There's a shy at the bowler's end but it misses.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

FOUR! Edged and it's safe! Lakmal is bowling extremely well here. Fuller in length and outside off, Chari prods forward to defend but the ball takes the outside edge. It flies past the diving first slip fielder and races away to the fence behind.
Good length delivery outside off, Chari has nothing to do with that one. Leaves it alone for the keeper to collect.
On middle and off, worked to the on side for no run.

HUGE LBW APPEAL! That seemed really, really close to the naked eye. One would wonder if Rangana Herath should have taken the review on that occasion. Length delivery angling in sharply from outside off, Chari looks to flick it across the line but misses and is hit on the pads. There's a loud appeal for a leg before but the umpire isn't interested. The Lankan team contemplate long and hard and in the end, Herath decides against taking the review. Good decision in the end, replays confirm the ball was just clipping the leg stump and so, it would have been the umpire's call.
Short and wide outside off, it's punched off the back foot to the off side for nothing.
FOUR! He's found the gap nicely here. Full on middle and off, Williams kneels down to this one and sweeps it over square leg to pick up a boundary.
Similar ball, same shot offered.
Flatter one once more on middle and leg, Sean goes back and manages to get his bat down in time to defend.
Fuller around off, Sean gets an inside edge onto his body as he attempts to sweep it away.
Starts off from around the wicket and bowls a flatter delivery on middle and leg, it's drifting in as Williams keeps it out off the front foot.
Dilruwan Perera is brought into the bowling attack.
Length ball on middle and off, solidly kept out from within the crease to end the over.

Some nice carry once more. It's fired in on a fuller length outside off, it's seaming away as Perera collects it by shuffling across a few steps to his right. Takes it at a comfortable height once more.
Nice length ball in the channel outside off, Brian is careful as he plants his front foot forward to let it be.
Fullish length ball outside off, it's driven back down to mid off. Won't get any run for it.
Good length delivery aiming the top of off stump, once again Brain Chari stays behind the line and keeps it out with a straight blade.
Fuller length delivery on off, Brian stays perfectly behind the line and blocks.
Another solid front foot defense from Sean Williams to keep this one out and that will be the end of the over.
Floats this one up outside off, Sean Williams presses forward in an instant and defends it on the off side.
Pitched on a length this time but it's still quite loopy, kept out off the back foot.
Over the wicket now to the southpaw, Herath flights it up nicely on middle and off, Williams comes forward and works it past the short leg fielder for no run.
Looped up around off, Chari makes good use of his feet to get to the pitch of the delivery and drives it down to long off for a single.
Herath continues from around the wicket and tosses it up on middle and off, a solid front foot defense from Brian Chari to keep it out.
Back of a length delivery outside off, tapped away on the off side off the back foot to end the over.
A bouncer from Suranga, Sean Williams ducks and lets it sail over him. Once again there's some extra bounce for the Lankan pacer.
Fuller in length but it's well outside off, no problem for Sean Williams to leave it alone.
Lakmal has a change of angle and comes from around the wicket, fires it in full and it's angling in from outside off, Williams is careful as he lets it go past him.
Fullish in length and it's just around the off stump, Williams prods forward and pushes it back down the track.
Pitches this just back of a length and around off, Sean stays back and guides it down to third man for a couple of runs.

FOUR! Swept away! Tossed up delivery around middle and off, Chari gets down on one knee and sweeps it through deep square leg for a boundary. He was trying to play that shot since the start of the day and finally gets one right.
A slider around middle, angling in as Chari makes a solid defense with his bat close to pad.
Comes from over the wicket and hurls a loopy ball around off. Williams plunges forward and pushes it towards covers for a single.
Floats it up around off, Chari skips down the track and drives it towards long off for a single.
Slower through the air and around off, Brian comes forward and defends it in front of short leg off the inside edge.
Around middle and leg, Chari tries to sweep it across the line but drags it off the inner part of the bat towards short fine leg.

FOUR! Edged and away! Back of a length delivery outside off, Williams plays this with an angled bat. But he does so with soft hands and that saves him. It falls short of the diving gully fielder and goes past him away to the third man fence for a boundary.
Back of a length delivery outside off, blocked off the back foot to keep it out.

Well.... What do we have here? A bit of bounce now for Suranga Lakmal. Runs in hard and bowls it on a good length outside off, the ball shoots off the surface as Williams shoulders his arms to that one. Good carry on that as Kusal Perera collects it at a good height.
Sean Williams is the next batsman in!

OUT! LAKMAL STRIKES! And what a delivery this is. Sri Lanka really needed this. The pacer was bowling really well and he's gotten the desired result. Excellent length delivery just outside off, there's some late away movement as Ervine has a poke at it. That does him in as the ball takes a healthy edge. It flies to Dimuth Karunaratne at first slip who doesn't make any mistake in taking that. A fighting knock from Craig Ervine comes to an end and the 117-run stand has been broken.
Full ball seaming away from around off, Craig Ervine leans ahead and drives it hard straight to the man at mid off.
Tight line to start the over with, it's shaping in on a length on middle and off, Chari leans across a bit and tucks it through to fine leg for a single.

NOT OUT! The decision is overturned! But what was Craig Ervine doing? This is a Test match! Tossed up ball around middle and off, Ervine gets into the position to reverse sweep but misses as the ball goes off something and lobs towards short leg where the fielder takes the catch. They all appeal and the umpire gives it out. Craig immediately takes the review and replays show it came off the arm guard and that can't be given out. Ian Gould will have to change his decision as Craig survives a scare here.
A catch appeal is refereed upstairs against Craig Ervine!
Makes a long stride forward and defends it watchfully.
Pushes it towards covers and calls for a single. The fielder charges to the ball and denies them a single.
Flattish through the air and skidding in with the angle. Craig gets back and defends it gently.
Loopy ball around off, Ervine prods forward and keeps it out well.
Around middle and off, Ervine comes forward to defend but gets it off the outer part of the bat towards point.

Excellent, excellent yorker from Suranga Lakmal. Spears it in on middle and leg and it's swinging in as well, Brian does well to bring his bat down in time and keep it out on the on side. Terrific delivery to end the over.
Brian Chari walks out to this one and taps this back of a length delivery outside off in front of covers. Wants the single but is sent back by his partner.
Fuller length delivery tailing in on middle and off, Brian leans forward and works it towards mid-wicket off the inside half of the bat.
Another bumper from Suranga Lakmal, another duck from Chari. Very watchful as he does so as well.
Lakmal brings out the short one and bangs it in on off, Brian Chari does well to duck under it comfortably.
Full and fired in on middle and leg, Chari works it straight to the man at short mid-wicket.
Flat and short around leg, Chari camps back and punches it towards long on to keep strike.
A slider down the leg side, Ervine gets down and sweeps it to fine leg for a single.
Loopy ball around off, Craig comes down the track and blocks it out.
BC comes down the track and drives it down to long on for a single.

Just short of short leg! Full and around middle, Chari looks to defend it off the front foot but gets it off the inner part of the bat towards short leg and is lucky as the ball goes on the bounce to the man there.
Floated ball around middle, Ervine gets down and sweeps it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Very full and served in the channel on off, Chari presses forward and offers a solid defense.
Fuller and angling in from outside off, Chari gets forward and makes a watchful leave to the keeper.
Good length ball on off, Brian gets right behind the line and defends it well.
Second slip moves to short mid-wicket now...
Fuller and angling in, Chari looks to flick it across the line but misses and is hit on the pads. No appeal has been made as it was going down leg.
Back of a length ball on middle, Chari gets back and offers a straight bat defense.
Length ball outside off, Ervine punches it towards covers for a single.
An arm ball around leg, Chari is late to put his bat down and is hit on the pads.
Goes back to around the wicket and loops it up around off, Chari blocks it well on the off side.
On middle and leg, nudged through square leg for a single.
Herath comes from over the wicket and tosses it up around off, Craig presses forward and keeps it out.
First runs of the day! Gets back to this flatter ball and works it through mid-wicket for a single.

In the air... safe! Was there an inside edge? Tossed up ball around middle and leg, Chari prods forward to defend but misses as the ball lobs towards short leg. The fielder tries to get to it with a dive to his left but fails to do so. Replays show there was a thick inside edge. Chance goes abegging.
Good delivery from Suranga Lakmal to end the over as he pitches it on a length and aims the top of off stump, Ervine is rock steady in his defense as he keeps it out with a straight bat.
AN EDGE WHICH HASN'T CARRIED! Back of a length delivery outside off, Craig Ervine has a poke at it as the ball takes the outside edge. Fortunately for him, it falls short of the third slip fielder.
On a good length once more, but it's well outside off this time, no trouble for the left-hander to leave this one alone.
Hint of reverse swing there. That'll encourage the pacer. Good length delivery on off, Ervine stays back to this one and sees out the reverse swing solidly.

WAS THAT OUT? What just happened there? So, so close. Lakmal comes steaming in with a length delivery just around the off stump. There's a hint of away movement and it's very late, Ervine looks to play at it and there's a noise just as the ball goes past the outside edge. Sri Lanka appeal for a caught behind but the umpire is unmoved. Replays confirm why, and it's a good decision. The noise came from the bat hitting the pad and not the ball.
Lakmal starts off with a rather harmless delivery. Pitches it on a length and makes it go away from Ervine from around off, it's watchfully left alone by the southpaw.
Suranga Lakmal will bowl from the other end.

Tossed up ball around middle, skids in and stays a touch low as well. Brian gets back to flick but is beaten by the lack of bounce as the ball hits him on the pads and rolls back to Herath. A maiden to start with!
Floated ball around off, Chari prods forward to defend but ends up defending it a bit uppishly towards the vacant silly point region. Had a fielder there in place, that could have been a catch.
A silly point in place now...
Flatter one around middle, Chari gets back and flicks it towards the leg side.
Flighted ball around off, Chari gets forward and defends it down gently.
Tossed up around middle and off, defended into the ground.
Floated ball around off, Chari comes forward and blocks it out.

It's time to play the game. The umpires and players have made their way out to the middle. It will be Brian Chari and Craig Ervine to bat for the hosts. Rangana Herath will start off with the bowling proceedings. Let's play...

The home side would want the duo to reduce the deficit as much as possible and it would be highly interesting to see if they will be able to continue from where they left off yesterday. Sri Lanka will look to come out and bowl the hosts out and tighten their grip on this game as well. Let's see how the day pans out. Stay tuned as the action is about to begin...

Hello and a warm welcome for day 3 of this second Test between Zimbabwe and Sri Lanka. After putting up a huge total on the board, Sri Lanka's skipper Rangana Herath didn't waste any time as he scalped two quick wickets to put the hosts in further trouble. However, what happened next wasn't expected as the current pair of Chari and Ervine came to the fore and not only saw off the day but have scored runs at a brisk rate.
... DAY 3, SESSION 1...

Zimbabwe still trail by a massive 378-run margin and will need to bat exceedingly well tomorrow to remain in hunt. The visitors on the other side would aim to break the current stand immediately and make early inroads. Promises to be an exciting day 3. Do join us at 1330 IST for all the action.

After a worst possible start, the pair of Brian Chari and Craig Ervine have joined forces and stitched in a 109-run partnership to settle the nerves in the dressing room. The Sri Lankan bowlers toiled hard but weren't penetrative enough.

Good day of Test cricket! Sri Lanka will be satisfied with their overall effort on the second day. Firstly, powered by Asela Gunaratne's century, they posted a total in excess of 500 and then skipper Rangana Herath nipped out a couple of quick wickets in one over to push Zimbabwe on the back foot.
Full and outside off once more, Ervine leans and pushes it away to end the day. STUMPS ON DAY 2, ZIMBABWE TRAIL BY 378!
Full and just outside off, watchfully defended.
Landed around off again, Craig goes back to cut but is too close to the ball and gets a bottom edge towards point.
Landed around off, blocked to the off side.
Fuller and straighter, defended back to the bowler.

FOUR! A short ball around off, Ervine goes back and tucks it through mid-wicket. The ball teases the chasing fielders and wins the race. Moves to 60 with his 8th boundary. 179 more needed to avoid the follow-on.
We are down to the last over of the day as play goes into extended time... DHANANJAYA DE SILVA is going to bowl it. Can he break this partnership?
Similar ball, another watchful defense.
Full and outside off, Brian lunges and blocks it back.
A touch shorter outside off, Chari goes right back to defend.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Down the leg side, Ervine looks to paddle but misses. The ball goes off his glove past the keeper and the batsmen take a single by the time first slip gets to it.
Full on middle and off, defended back to the bowler.
DILRUWAN PERERA to bowl the penultimate over of the day.
Full and outside off, driven towards mid off.
Down the leg side, tucked through fine leg for a single.
Full and outside off, driven towards mid off.

NOT OUT. Waste of a review. On a good length around middle, Brian looks to clip but misses and is hit on the pads. There is a massive appeal for LBW but the umpire moves away and the batsmen take a single. He signals a leg bye and the Lankans have a chat. Kusal Perera signals Herath to go for the review and boy, this is some review. Impact itself is nearly outside leg and the ball is heading further down. Desperate stuff. The decision stays as it is.
Appeal for an lbw. Not given and Rangana Herath signals for the DRS. Looks to be missing leg. Let's see...
On middle and leg, pushed towards mid on.
On a good length outside off, Chari comes forward and pushes it towards cover.
Full on middle and off, CE lunges to defend but the ball squirts off the inside edge wide of short leg towards mid-wicket.
A short ball down the leg side, Craig looks to pull but misses.

Full and outside off, Ervine looks for a paddle but misses. The ball stays low, goes between Kusal Perera's legs off his gloves and is not stopped by first slip  in spite of a dive to his right. The batsmen take a couple of byes.
The 100-run stand is up now! Excellent fightback.
Goes back and punches it towards widish long on for a single. Moves to 60.
Full on middle, flicked towards short leg.
Landed outside off, stays low, Chari punches it off the back foot and the ball goes off the toe end towards cover.
On a good length around off, defended to the leg side for a run. 189 more needed to avoid the follow-on.
Full and around off, watchfully blocked back to the bowler.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.
Outside off, eased through the covers for a single. The deficit is now 389.
Full and just outside off, watchfully defended towards cover.
Full and outside off, blocked towards point for a single.
On middle and leg, THAT STAYED LOW, but Ervine managed to keep it out.
Full and outside off, driven towards widish long off for a run.
On middle and leg, a touch short, punched towards the bowler.
Full and outside off, defended watchfully.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Full on middle and off, watchfully defended back to the bowler.
On a fuller length again, outside off, this time Brian shoulders arms.
FOUR! Majestic! Picture-perfect shot. Full and outside off, Chari comes forward and drives it through the covers for a boundary!
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
A short ball outside off, Ervine goes for the pull but gets a top edge which does not carry to deep mid-wicket. A single taken. The stand moves to 90.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On a good length outside off, punched towards mid off.
SURANGA LAKMAL has been brought back on. 7 overs left in the day.
Full and outside off, watchfully kept out.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
The arm ball on middle, rushes on to Chari as he looks to defend and goes off the inside edge onto his pads.
Full and outside off, worked towards long on for a single. 199 more needed to avoid the follow-on.
Second Test Fifty for Ervine! Now can he convert that into a century?

FOUR! Hammered! Full and outside off, Ervine gets down and sweeps it powerfully through square leg for a boundary to bring up his half century! It has been a wonderful counter-attacking knock, having come in after Herath removed two quickly. The deficit is now 399.
Full and straight, defended back to the bowler.
Landed outside off, flayed behind point for a couple to bring up ZIMBABWE'S 100.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Short and outside off, cut through point. There is a slight mix-up but eventually they take the single.
Full and straight, defended to the off side.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
MAIDEN TEST FIFTY FOR BRIAN CHARI!

SIX! Wow, great connection on this occasion and he reaches his fifty in grand style. Loopy ball on middle, Chari goes down on one knee and hammers it all the way over wide long on for a maximum. Great knock by the opener. He has been particularly severe on Herath, targeting him from ball one.
FOUR! Flighted ball on off, Chari clears his front leg and tries to slog it over mid-wicket but it catches the inner half of the bat and squirts through square leg for a boundary.
Strides forward to a full ball and pushes it to covers.
Floated ball on middle, not turning much, Chari fails to defend and is pinged on the front pad. They appeal but the umpire shakes his head. The replays detect an inside edge.
A low full toss on off, Ervine sweeps it through backward square leg for a single.
RANGANA HERATH is back on.
Pitches it full and on off, Chari drives it off his front foot to mid off.
Angles in a length ball on middle, Brian defends it with a straight bat.
Good length ball outside off, it's punched from the back foot by Chari just past the bowler towards mid off.
Full in length and outside off, left alone.
Short and wide outside off, cut past the diving backward point fielder for a couple of runs.
Back of a length ball on off, it's punched back to the bowler.
This is interesting. ASELA GUNARATNE has been given the ball. Looks like he will bowl medium pace.
A touch shorter on off, punched to covers.
Works it across the line and finds the gap at mid-wicket for one.
Flatter delivery on off, defended from the crease.

Oohhh...nearly rolled back onto the stumps. Tossed up ball on middle, Chari fails to connect with his sweep shot and is hit on the pads. They appeal but in the meanwhile the ball has rolled back and goes very closely past the stumps. A narrow escape.
Flighted and on middle, swept through square leg for a brace.
Flatter on off, punched from the crease to covers.
Length ball on off, Ervine stays back and taps it to cover-point.
Too full in length and darted in around off, blocked away by Ervine.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Too straight in line this time, Chari works it through square leg for a single.
Around off on a good length, Chari blocks it from the crease.
Full and angling into the batsman, Ervine nudges it down to long leg for a single.
Lunges to a full ball and defends it down to the off side.
Flighted on middle and leg, a controlled sweep shot towards backward square leg.
Turns a length ball through square leg for one.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up ball outside off, Chari kneels and sweeps it off the top half of the bat. It balloons in the air but doesn't carry to the fine leg fielder.
Flighted ball outside off, left alone.
Persists with his line around off and drops it on a fuller length, Craig defends it from the crease to end the over.
Lands it very full on off, Ervine digs it out off the inner half of the bat to mid on.
Angles in a full ball from around the wicket, Ervine gets forward and defends it back towards the bowler.
Back of a length ball on off, it's defended off the back foot to the off side.
Good length ball angling down the leg side, Chari glances it off his hips through square leg for a single.
Bouncer around middle and leg, ducked.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and pushes it back to the bowler.
Flatter around off. The batsman defends it from within the crease.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Lunges to a full ball and defends it on the leg side.
Gets on the front foot and defends it with an angled bat to point.
Appeal for an lbw as Ervine tries to play the sweep shot and misses. The appeal is not entertained as the impact looked outside off.

EDGED AND FOUR! Back of a length ball on off, Chari camps back to force it through the line but gets a massive outside edge behind. It flies between the space at first slip and keeper for a boundary. Both the Sri Lankan players were watching each other as it sneaks through. That was a keeper's catch and Perera should have gone for it.
Slants in a full ball on middle, Ervine nudges it in the gap on the leg side for one.
Short of a length ball outside off, Ervine stands tall and punches it to sweeper cover where Gunaratne makes a tumbling stop. A couple of runs taken.
Angles across a full ball outside off, from around the wicket, Ervine drives it off his front foot to covers.
Fractionally short in length around middle, Craig defends it off his back foot.
Stays back to a full length ball and chops it down towards point for a run.
Quicker and fuller on middle, forced down to long on for a single.
Flatter around off, it's defended off the back foot by Chari.
Leans forward and pushes a full ball through covers for a single.
50-run stand is up in just 71 balls!
Flighted on middle, knocked down through mid on for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

FOUR! Floated full ball on middle, Chari gets down and paddles it towards fine leg where Kumara gets across to stop the ball but fails to do so cleanly. He gets a partial touch on the ball which didn't stop the speeding ball. Eventually it trickles past the rope much to the disappointment of the bowler and the fielder.
Another pull shot played, this is straight to short mid-wicket.
A short ball around off, Chari swivels and pulls it towards fine leg for a single. That almost carried to the fielder.
Full and wide outside off, swinging in, left alone again.
A bouncer but down the leg side, Chari ducks.
Stays back again and defends.
On a good length outside off, angling in, defended from the crease.
FOUR! Fetch that! Full and wide outside off, Ervine comes forward and thrashes it through the covers for a boundary! 10 runs from Dilruwan's opening over.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and outside off, driven back to the bowler.
Lunges into this one, takes it on the full and paddles it fine once more for a couple. The stand is worth 40 from 59 balls. 248 more needed to avoid the follow-on.
Goes back and whips this towards the leg side but it hits short leg.
FOUR! Full and down the leg side, Ervine paddles it fine and gets it to the boundary! Moves to 32 from 37 balls with his 5th boundary. The deficit is now 49.
DILRUWAN PERERA gets a bowl now.
Full on middle, tailing in, BC does well to push it to extra cover.
Similar ball, this time Brian plays inside the line and gets beaten.
On a good length outside off, angling in, Chari defends it from his crease.
Banged in short again, pulled away once more, but this time straight to Dhananjaya de Silva at deep mid-wicket for a single.
On a good length outside off, left alone.
Short and outside off, pulled through mid-wicket for a couple. 50 UP FOR ZIMBABWE!
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Comes down the track and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off, CE lunges to defend but misses and is hit on the pads. Herath appeals but the impact was well outside off.
Landed outside off, Craig looks to punch it through the line but misses.
FOUR! Another lovely stroke. Full and around middle, Ervine gets down and paddles it to the fine leg fence. 258 more needed to avoid the follow-on. The stand moves to 30.
Full and on middle, defended in front of short leg.
Outside off, left alone.
On middle and leg, flicked wide of mid on for a run.
On a good length wide outside off, left alone.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
FOUR! Goes the other side this time, gets it too straight, on a length, Ervine tucks it to the fine leg fence.

FOUR! Magnificent! What a welcome. Full and outside off, Ervine comes forward and drives it wide of mid off and the timing takes the ball to the ropes. 267 more needed to avoid the follow-on. The stand is worth 21.
LAHIRU KUMARA comes on to bowl now.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
The arm ball, around middle, Brian stays back to defend but misses and is hit on the pads.
Landed outside off, defended back to the bowler.

Full and outside off, Ervine reaches out to flick but misses and the ball goes off his pads wide of slip. The Lankans appeal but umpire Gould moves away. Perhaps there might have been an inside edge as there is no signal of a leg bye when the batsmen took a single.
On middle and leg, worked towards short leg.
Landed outside off, pushed towards mid off for a quick single. Moves to 20 from 28 balls.
Outside off, not played at this one.
Full and wide outside off, driven straight to mid off.
Wide outside off, left alone.
Full and outside off, Brian pushes at it but gets an inside edge which goes past leg stump towards square leg. A single taken.
Landed outside off, swinging away, shouldered arms to.
Full and outside off, Chari comes forward to defend but gets an outside edge which does not carry to a diving second slip.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Landed outside off, a bit flatter, defended back to Herath.
Full and outside off, a bit of loop, Craig defends it back to the bowler.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full on off, Ervine comes down the track and flicks it towards short mid-wicket.

NOT OUT! Full and around middle, Chari gets down and looks to paddle it. The ball goes uppishly but does not carry to Suranga Lakmal at short fine leg. He comes charging in, takes it on the bounce and returns a good throw to the keeper who disturbs the stumps and appeals. It is referred upstairs but replays show that Ervine is safe. Replays show that Chari did not want the run actually but Ervine pushed him into it. Lakmal should have thrown it to the bowler instead.
Now then... a run out appeal against Ervine! Referred upstairs...
Better, comes forward and defends it to the off side.
Beaten! On a good length outside off, Craig punches it through the line but makes no connection with the ball.
Full and outside off, driven sweetly between mid off and cover for a couple. Moves to 10 from 11 balls.
Back of a length outside off, defended towards cover.
Short and outside off, punched through the covers for a run.
On middle and leg, flicked away for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and outside off, driven towards mid off.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.

NOT OUT! Massive inside edge. The arm ball outside off, Chari comes forward to defend but misses the line and is hit on the pads. Herath puts in a huge appeal and tumbles over while appealing. Umpire Ian Gould raises his finger and Chari reviews it instantaneously. Replays detect a thick inside edge. The decision is reversed.
Chari has been given out LBW! But he has reviewed it immediately.
Full on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple. 279 more needed to avoid the follow-on.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Outside off, left alone.
FOUR! Lovely! Full and outside off, Ervine comes forward and just pushes it. The timing is so sweet that the ball flies past cover to the fence.
Fuller in length and outside off, Ervine drives it wide of mid off for a couple of runs.
Angles across a full ball outside off, Ervine covers the line and shoulders arms.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
CRAIG ERVINE is in next.

OUT! Two in two for Herath! He is on fire. Flighted ball on off, spinning away a shade, Hamilton gets forward to defend but edges it behind. de Silva at first slip goes down low and takes a sharp catch. Masakadza cannot believe his luck and starts to walk reluctantly before the umpires stop him and go upstairs to check whether it's a clean catch or not. Sift signal given is out. The replays confirm it's cleanly taken by Dhananjaya de Silva and Hamilton has to continue with his long walk back to the pavilion. Zimbabwe off to a poor start.
Masakadza has nicked one ball towards first slip where the fielder has taken a low catch. The umpires want to check if it carried and ask the batsman to wait. Soft signal is out though.
Full and around off, Hamilton defends it off his front foot to the off side.
HAMILTON MASAKADZA is the new batsman.

OUT! Mawoyo is trapped in front! Herath dishes out an arm ball around off and gets it to skid on with the angle. Mawoyo leans forward in defense, playing for the away spin which isn't there. To his surprise and disappointment, it has rapped him on the pads and the finger has gone up after the lbw shout was made. An early setback for Zimbabwe.
Tossed up ball outside off, left alone.
Bowls a beauty to beat the batsman. It's on a fuller length and just outside off, holding its line, Brian pushes at it tamely and misses.
The umpire did the calculation wrong and was walking off after the fifth ball thinking it's over. The mistake is pointed out to him and he returns to his mark. Lakmal runs in...
Good brave leave. A length ball on off, shaping back in, Chari covers the line and shoulders arms. That wasn't very far from the off stump.
Full and around off, Chari solidly defends it by covering the line.
Serves it full and outside off, Chari tries to tap and run but it goes straight to cover-point and he aborts his plan.
Once again a full ball is angled into the batsman, Chari goes back and defends it to the leg side.
Full and angling into the batsman, Chari gets behind the line and defends it to the off side.
Slight hold up in play. Not sure what's the issue. Maybe something related to the sightscreen.
Mawoyo shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Lunges to a full ball and defends it watchfully.
Strides forward and defends it towards short leg who has an immediate shy at the striker's end. It's a direct hit but the batsman is safely in.
Fires a quicker one on middle and leg, Mawoyo fails to middle his sweep shot.
Loopy delivery outside off, a good leave by Mawoyo.
Floated one on off, Mawoyo defends it off his front foot.
Serves it full and outside off, it's pushed with an angled bat to gully.
Bouncer around leg, Chari ducks underneath it.

NOT OUT! Too high. Length ball landing outside off, nipping back in sharply, Chari decides not to offer any shot and is pinged high on the back leg. They appeal vociferously and the finger goes up. Brian immediately reviews it and the Hawk Eye shows that it's heading over the stumps. The decision is overturned.
Brian Chari has left a delivery only to get rapped on the pads. They appeal and the finger goes up. It's referred by the batsman.
Angles in a fuller length ball on off, Chari defends it off his front foot to the off side.
Length delivery again, around off, tapped down in the gap at covers for a quick single.
Serves it on a length around off, staying a bit low, Mawoyo sticks back and does well to keep it out on the leg side.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flighted and on middle, defended off the front foot.
Tossed up ball on off, defended off the front foot to silly point.
FOUR! Chari is taking on Herath! Floated full ball on off, Brian gets on the front foot with a straight bat and lofts it nonchalantly over the mid off for a boundary.
EDGY FOUR! A little bit of away spin this time, Chari tries to defend it off his front foot but gets an outside edge. It speeds wide of first slip and races through for a boundary.

SIX! Ho! Ho! Ho! What a way to get off the mark. Flighted ball on off, fuller in length, Chari goes down and gives it the full whack of his bat. Middles it decently and sends t flying over long on for a biggie.
RANGANA HERATH to share the new cherry from the other end. Interesting move. A slip, short leg and silly point...
